description: pixel art, the lower half of a pale young woman lady of shadows in dark grey and black fitted armour with silver edges and a long black cloak of shadow dissolving into dark smoke at the edges, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the hips sit on the saddle, the near thigh in black armour lies forward along the horse's back, the near lower leg in a dark armoured boot hangs straight down from the knee, the boot rests level in a stirrup that is not drawn; the black smoky cloak hangs down behind over the horse's back; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, transparent background
